geo_version_rule.historical: source classification must be read from table metadata at extraction time

sources.disclosure_note: Treat as contextual/marginal source unless a joint MRP cell definition is explicitly supported.

synthesis_guardrail.prohibited: Do not multiply independent marginal tables to manufacture a joint population distribution.
allowed: Use an observed joint table as a poststratification frame for the dimensions actually present.
Use separate context covariates as area-level predictors without pretending they form joint population cells.
Use an additional authorized source when a richer joint cell distribution is required.
